description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer service within the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to code reviews, repository management, feedback, and resource tagging.

classes.name: CodeGuruReviewerClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer API interactions, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateRepository
methods.description: Associates a repository with CodeGuru Reviewer.

methods.name: createCodeReview
methods.description: Creates a new code review in CodeGuru Reviewer.

methods.name: describeCodeReview
methods.description: Provides details about a specific code review.

methods.name: describeRecommendationFeedback
methods.description: Returns feedback about recommendations given during a code review.

methods.name: disassociateRepository
methods.description: Removes the association between a repository and CodeGuru Reviewer.

methods.name: listCodeReviews
methods.description: Lists all code reviews in the account.

methods.name: listRecommendations
methods.description: Lists recommendations generated for code reviews.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.
